name: Kirulean Meditant (CR 1/2)
body:
KIRULEAN MEDITANT
CR 1/2

This humanoid has pale, cream-colored skin. She closely resembles a human except for her head, which is a lumpy, conical shape and extremely tall. She is bald, except for a knot of dark hair at the top of this dome, and drapes down her back in a ponytail. She is dressed in green silk robes.

XP 200
Kirulean monk (enlightened monk) 1
LN Medium humanoid (kirulean, psionic)
Init +3; Senses Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 14, flat-footed 13 (+1 dodge, +3 monk)
hp 10 (1d8+1+1)
Fort +3, Ref +5, Will +5
Defensive Abilities intuitive reflexes

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee unarmed strike +1/+1 (1d6+2 B) or unarmed strike +3 (1d6+2 B)
Ranged light crossbow +0 (1d8 P, 19-20/×2, range incr. 80 ft.; AP 1)
Special Attacks flurry of blows (+1 attack), stunning fist (1/day, expend psionic focus for +1 to DC), unarmed strike (1d6)

Psi-Like Abilities (ML 1st; concentration +2)

1/day—synesthete

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 10, Con 13, Int 8, Wis 16, Cha 12
Base Atk +0; CMB +2; CMD 16
Feats Dodge, Improved Unarmed Strike, Psionic Fist, Stunning Fist, Wild Talent
Skills Autohypnosis +9, Perception +7, Sense Motive +7; Species Modifiers +2 Autohypnosis
Languages Common, Kirulean
SQ psionics (2 pp)
Gear NPC gear (light crossbow with 10 bolts, other gear)

ABOUT

Kiruleans are wise and perceptive. As a species struggling with a low and declining population, they are all-too-aware of their own mortality, and eager to promote peaceful solutions to conflict. Kirulean meditants are often called upon to keep the peace. Capable of fighting lethally or nonlethally, a meditant approaches their opponent philosophically—and tries to find common ground wherever possible.
